items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1959-10-03
items.q: And the other fella, they called him String Bean. Tall, slim fella. Guy never about to touch that ceiling when he stand up. That's right. They used to call him String Bean. Some guys called him Big Long Boy. Yeah, called him Long Boy. He died too.

ctx.x: Was it a nice, quiet neighborhood?

Oh man, them guys was tough out there. All them guys had 16 shooter Winchester. That's why they called it the battlefield. Guys so tough out there. Whenever they had a humbug in the battlefield, you couldn't get the peace. You couldn't get that, you called the laws up. They wasn't gone out there in the battlefield. Them guys was bad out there. And they had a gang of them Peen brothers out there. Thomas Peen, he got killed. Thomas Peen, Harry Peen, Willie Peen. All them guys was hogs out there. Bad, you know. And…
Did anybody ever get hurt out there?
